package rulefixtures

import (
	"time"
)

// scenario for ticker_without_stop: time.NewTicker(...) is created without an observed Stop() call.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: idioms; severity: info.
func scenario399Positive(stopCh <-chan struct{}) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(500 * time.Millisecond)
	for {
		select {
		case <-ticker.C:
			_ = len(stopCh)
		case <-stopCh:
			return
		}
	}
}
